title: Ye Bhayamu – Vinod Kumar, Benjamin Johnson Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: ఏ భయము నాకు లేనేలేదుగా నీవు తోడుండగా
ఏ దిగులు నాకు లేనేలేదుగా నీ కృప నా తోడుండగా
పగిలిపోయిన ప్రతీ పాత్రను సరిచేయగల పరమ కుమ్మరి
english: Ye bhayamu naku lene ledhu ga – neevu thodundaga
ye dhigulu naku lene ledhu ga – nee krupa na thonundaga
pagili poyina prathi pathranu sari cheyagala parama kummari

credits.Vocals: Pastor Vinod Kumar, Pastor Benjamin Johnson and Christ Alone Music Team

intro: Ye Bhayamu is the latest Telugu Christian song written and tuned by Pastor Vinod Kumar, sung by Pastor Vinod Kumar and Pastor Benjamin Johnson and music composed by Moses Dany. This song was released on May 24, 2023 through Pastor Vinod Kumar YouTube channel.
